book.name: Malaka
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Malaka byex o

content: Vako me nilaxes
Xel Parisi me xel putoung wei petieing eno valu wei lam anghei Yerusalem eno qekuma is Yesu,
me yei e xe betiyeing on valu se betiwou kwa wei Yudayeiw wei xel mi sekweyexe memend o qe xel di ya yaeing is memend laxes.
(Parisi me xel dalus wei Yudayeiw eno se mi ya qe ka xel mi sekweyexe memend wole, nambei xel xe kwa wei buyeiw takwei yo.
Gyeik xel nam anghei ingwei beyeeng vateivek ond xel se mi ya qe ka xel lipek wole. Me xel mi betiwou lul ngenong valu wei buyeiw takwei yo, nambei ingwei sekweyexeing mayamya, deng, me dengmuing.)
Om Parisiyeiw me xel putoung wei petieing o teling Yesu, “Nambei nya wa xe xel betiyeing se mi wong e teyei lek kwa takwei wei xel bundyeiw o qe xel mi ya xend yaeing is memend laxes?”
E neil elox, “Yesaya neil zonghek gyeik e neil qayeeng poropet en xam wei myamim yuw o. En nambei xel byex eivek qapiya eno nambei nye,

content.text: “‘Xomaxoneing ti beimambei yon mi sanghoxe ay angya myend bandaing,
ekom xel laleind on mindei dingta veil ay.
Xel mi wong lalo wou ay bandaing.
Ekom xel mi teyoxe xomaxoneing bei xel a mi betiwou petieing ne nambei Anutu xe.’ Yesaya 29:13

content: Xam ghe saing Anutu xe petieing dom ghe di zeimaxoun xomaxoneing xe kwa wei takwei yo.”
Me e neil wou xel, “Xam ghe woulek ewo nimza en kwa wei toungeing Anutu xe petieing la dei nenyawes bei kandek betiwou bumyeiw xe kwa wei takwei yo!
En Mose neil, ‘Wa mi gwevek mam aluw tam xe qayeeng,’ de ‘Eti yeiw wei neil vyalek ma luw ta eno xel nyeis e mey.’
Ekom xam ghe neimbei wangwei moux ti e neil wou mamata, ‘Vineing vati wei a bei bong wou muw eno inye kolban qes ambei nye lulul da wei a beyal bei na bong wou Anutu yo,’
woyom wa seng wong e lox me la wo vineing ti wou ma o ta.
Nambei xam ghe wong nikanzek wei Anutu xe xoulek eno ma dom ghe mi betiwou xam xe kwa takwei wei xam ghe mi qou wou bumyeiw o. Me ghe wong lulul ngenong ambei nyon.”
Yesu taxe xel xomaxoneing ngenong la wou e no me neil, “Xam dalus a ngo wou ay, me na mi bou kwamim en tine bo nimza.
Lul tiwei mindei myayaing me la eivek xomaxoneing eno se teyeimbei bong embo nilaxes. Qe vati wei lam myayaing veil xomaxoneing laleind eno tiyon mi wong e wo nilaxes.”
Gyeik e ghanaw xel qendu tiyon me la eivek xomek, e xe xel betiyeing teling e en qayeeng pakeing tine.
Moxo neil bei, “En xam is ambei nyon xam seng woulek qayeeng ne qes? Beip xam seng woulek bei lulti mi la eivek xomaxoneing nanghei myayaing eno se teyeimbei bong embo nilaxes?
Lulul ne eno se teyei bei na eivek e lalei qe tyek na eivek e xeita, de e laluwexe ela myayaing eivek leiveeng.” (Eivek neileing tine, Yesu neilteyei bei lul yaeing dalus on vako.)
Moxo neil no bei, “Vati wei lam myayaing veil xomaxoneing eno inye wong e wo nilaxes.
En lam eivek xomaxoneing laleind eno inyon woueing nalei nilul, kwa nilul wei kwapesiv o, panaxeing, leiseing xel a mey.

Wongeing kwapesiv is vex wei dei leya yo, kwa eivekeing, yei tambiy nge wo nol, tyonyeing, kwa wei betiyeing wou lalei vineing wei neing o, yeimalek, lukyak lek tambiy nge, byexeing vaxa, me kwa wei bandol o.
Kwa nilul beimambei ne dalus eno lam eivek xomaxoneing laleind me wong xomaxoneing wo nilaxes.”
Vex wei Ponisia eno xe wongeingis
Yesu la veil beyeeng tiyon me la danghei tiwei Taia nei. E la eivek xomek on ti de embei xelti se boulek e. Ekom se teyeimbei bun xow.
Qe lutika eno vex tiwei laweeng nilaxes dei eivek neu vex eno ngo qayeeng en e, lam ev vaxa qatu me yeip ma eivek wou e vaxa.
Vex tiyon inyon nanghei Grik, me umbek eivek Siria Ponisia. Vexo tay wou Yesu bei e tiy memo yon na myayaing veil e neu vex.
Moxo neil wou vex on, “Xey a bong yakyak gya vati wei xel laleind vind o dalus me na pup atax bole, en inye se nimza bei qoueing yakyak xe belet me banex ena wou naw.”
Vexo neil elox, “Ee, Tambiy Ngandoung, ekom xel naw mi ya yaeing myapapu wei yakyak mi wong e mi teila eivek lelek xeinghembi yo.”
Woyom moxo neil wou vex on, “Wang neil e loum ambei nyon om wang na, en memo la veil neum vexo.”
Vexo lox beeng me yeimbei neu vexo di yeip lek zek dom memo yon la veil e.
Yesu wong moux ti nenya luw myatueing wo nimzalek
Woyom Yesu la veil beyeeng danghei wei Taia me la lox danghei wei Saidon, me la lox danghei wei Dekapolis me la tyip ninei wei lounyeing Galili ne.
Nanghei inyon eno xomaxoneing valu qou moux wei nenya wo qatu me mya wo nimaying om se teyeimbei baluk embo nimza yo me lam wou Yesu me xel tay wou e, bei e ni mema lek moux on.
Ka Yesu qou moux on me la nenyawes, dingta ka veil xel qendu ngandoung on, de moxo toung mema deyis la eivek moux on nenya luw. Woyom pesuv myalouk me toung mema deyis lek moux on ghas.
Moxo yeila tyoung gheyapu dom poux laweeng nikanzek me neil wou e, “Epata.” Qes ambei nye, “Wa tax!”
De lutika eno moux moxo nenya deng, me ghas tul de moxo luk eyeip yaing.
Yesu peti xel lumama bei eti se neil wou xelti en lul tiwei xel yei yo, ekom xel wo nikanzek en neileing qayeeng tine teyei.
Xomaxoneing on etek niseikeing. De xel neil, “Moxo wong lul sapa wo nimza. Moxo wong nenya qatu ngo wou me myatueing eno luk.”

footnotes.text: -16 Xel wei lupeyei yo valu wou naleind bei Malaka byex qayeeng tine eivek qapiya is: Wangwei xelti nenya bei e ngo, ond wong e ngo wou qayeeng.
